items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I called him Chinese Charlie. That's all I know.

ctx.x: No. I don't smoke no kind of cigarettes. Nothing, huh? Nothing. No. But I mean, brother said, yeah. This guy, yeah, he's still living. Walter Deku. You know him, man? Yeah. Well, he's still living. You know that? I didn't know that. Yeah, he's a wino. He drinks wine like that. I don't know. Walter Deku? Walter Deku? Walter Deku. Do you know how to find him? Huh? I wouldn't know. I don't know where he's in. I haven't seen him. I don't know. I used to play with him at the old folks home now when he was playing…
I don't know. I called him Chinese Charlie. That's all I know. He used to like tell the role of Mokin. Yeah.
Did he sing Chinese Charlie? No, he never sang. He played piano. He was a good piano player.
